name: coap_lci_auth
description: Independent test vectors for LICHEN CoAP LCI authorization. Validates is_local_admin checks for mutating CoAP resources per spec/17-lci.md section 17.6.3 Access Control.

vectors.name: loopback_is_admin
vectors.description: ::1 loopback address is always admin. PUT /config from loopback returns 2.04 Changed.

vectors.name: slip_link_local_is_admin
vectors.description: fe80::1 from the SLIP LCI transport interface is admin. PUT /config from SLIP LCI returns 2.04 Changed.

vectors.name: mesh_link_local_is_forbidden
vectors.description: fe80::1 from a non-SLIP mesh interface (e.g., LoRa) is NOT admin. PUT /config returns 4.01 Unauthorized.

vectors.name: global_ula_is_forbidden
vectors.description: fd00::1 global ULA is NOT admin. PUT /config returns 4.01 Unauthorized.

vectors.name: global_gua_is_forbidden
vectors.description: 2001:db8::1 global unicast address is NOT admin. PUT /config returns 4.01 Unauthorized.

vectors.name: null_addr_ztest_context
vectors.description: NULL addr in ZTEST (unit test) context returns true as a test escape hatch. PUT /config is allowed.

vectors.name: inbox_mesh_peer_unauthorized
vectors.description: POST /msg/inbox from mesh link-local without OSCORE returns 4.01 Unauthorized.

vectors.name: keys_put_mesh_peer_unauthorized
vectors.description: PUT /keys/{iid} from mesh link-local returns 4.01 Unauthorized. Key management is admin-only.

vectors.name: deaddrop_mesh_peer_unauthorized
vectors.description: POST /deaddrop from mesh link-local without OSCORE returns 4.01 Unauthorized.

vectors.name: msg_sent_local_admin
vectors.description: POST /msg/sent from loopback succeeds. Loopback is always admin.

vectors.name: msg_sent_mesh_forbidden
vectors.description: POST /msg/sent from mesh link-local returns 4.01 Unauthorized. Only admin can write to sent mailbox.

vectors.name: msg_ack_local_admin
vectors.description: POST /msg/ack from SLIP link-local succeeds. SLIP LCI is admin transport.

vectors.name: config_read_public
vectors.description: GET /config from any source succeeds. Read-only operations are always allowed regardless of admin status.

vectors.name: null_addr_explicitly_admin
vectors.description: NULL addr in ZTEST context is explicitly admin. Duplicate coverage for the null escape hatch path.
